history.subject: Degree lane, W5: the degree homomorphism on the Čech Picard group and the E-i..E-iii interface. classDeg : Additive Pic(X) →+ ℤ — the degree of any divisor presenting the class, well-defined because equal classes differ by a principal divisor (extraction) and principal divisors have degree zero (the χ-ledger), total by surjectivity; carrier chosen so values are honest integers with the hom laws free (an AddMonoidHom out of the additivized Picard group rather than Multiplicative-ℤ wrappers). E-i: classDeg [𝒪(D)] = deg D for every Weil divisor. E-ii: classDeg (L·L') = classDeg L + classDeg L'. E-iii: χ(𝒪(D)) = χ(𝒪) + classDeg [𝒪(D)], with the finiteness-free class-invariance χ(𝒪(D)) = χ(𝒪(D')) whenever [𝒪(D)] = [𝒪(D')] (extraction + the multiplication isomorphism + χ-transport — no choice anywhere). Curve form: χ(𝒪(D)) = 1 − genus C + classDeg [𝒪(D)] on the challenge curve, side-condition-free. The two structure-sheaf finiteness hypotheses ride exactly where the ledger needs them; the pushforward-rank reading of E-i deferred as its own statement. RiemannRoch/Degree.lean; root build 8684 jobs, all ten keystones independently verified axiom-clean

(C2) effectivity campaign, E0: the cg-saturated affine pieces of the curve product. The cover inclusion cg on the curve product is an affine morphism, so preimages of affine opens are affine; the ring identification is ON THE NOSE — Γ(cg⁻¹V) ≃ₐ[Γ(V)] Γ(V) ⊗[A] B via the pushout-of-sections square (the recon's unverified risk resolved, not mitigated: the affine-case pushout needs no flatness and no properness, and the private (C1) sections-pushout pattern generalizes publicly), with s⊗1 ↦ cg♯s making it Γ(V)-linear; faithful flatness of each piece cover by base-change stability; the restriction seam pieceRingEquiv_naturality along W ≤ V (the exact compat the per-piece descent and the splice consume — no further seam lemma needed); arbitrarily small saturated affine neighborhoods from the affine basis; and separatedness of the curve product under properness giving affine intersections. Hypothesis budget dissolves the recon's instance-threading risk for E0: the core needs neither properness nor geometric conditions nor faithful flatness. E0→E2 frontier recorded: the same identification R-uniformly at R = B⊗B (the descent-cocycle ring) plus the coprojection-face compatibility. Design: the Wave-4 FLV worksheet — fibrewise large-twist vanishing WITHOUT duality and without R^i f_*, by increasing-lattice exhaustion on the π-two-cover: for 𝒪(D + n·F) the section lattices are constant except the u⁻ⁿ-growing one, so Čech H¹ is an increasing quotient chain that exhausts by pole-clearing at the finite fiber while its base has finite codimension (the landed dévissage finiteness), forcing vanishing for n ≥ n₀(D) — per-class and non-effective, exactly the Kleiman-strata default; a degree-arithmetic reduction lifts the fiber case to arbitrary classes of positive degree, so no ℙ¹ base-change identification is ever needed. W6 SPLIT AND HALF-COLLAPSED: W6-lite (h⁰/h¹ of a class, well-defined) is a few lines on landed API (h0/h1_congr + the multiplication isomorphism + extraction) and stops being a campaign; W6-full (the engine-sheaf identification) is real but owned by the datum seam. Six sub-bricks with the single Fable heart isolated (FLV-3 exhaustion endgame); the campaign's one gate is the w4-1 QcohOn interface (mitigated: attached to the port's acceptance + two staged fallbacks so FLV cannot be walled)

(C2) effectivity campaign, E1 first landing: the σ-normalized coherent comparison — packaging and existence, WITH NO GEOMETRIC HYPOTHESES. The Stage-0 design (binding, recorded in the structure docstring): the comparison is a unit 0-cochain θ on a plain pointed-cover common refinement of the two coface pullbacks (no basic refinement — the curve product is not affine), with (N1) the witness relation θ_x · u₁♯γ = u₂♯γ · θ_y, and (N2) the ρ-RELATIVE normalization — D4 amended: 'σ-restriction = 1' is not stateable at the cochain level since rigidification kills only the class; the honest statement is σ♯θ = q₁♯ρ / q₂♯ρ against a section-trivializing cochain ρ carried as a field. Disconnectedness of the étale covers is invisible: every gluing step is the unit-sheaf axiom and the lm:aut bijection holds over arbitrary affine tests — no clopen calculus, no integrality. Existence lands from rigidification + the on-the-nose descent equation alone: the σ-defect of any witness glues to a global unit of the double base, and the correction is division by its projection pullback. Second D4 amendment, sharper than designed: COHERENCE (N3) is a THEOREM about every such datum, not a structure field — the section pins the cochain so rigidly that the triple-coface identity follows from (N1)+(N2), consuming the geometric triple only through lm:aut at the triple tensor. Its full proof is WRITTEN in two header-marked frontier files (ComparisonDefect, ComparisonCoherence — deliberately NOT imported: the closing steps hit kernel deterministic timeouts on the pair-indexed triple-product towers, with three diagnosed continuation options recorded in the headers; no sorries anywhere). Face conventions match Module.IsDescentCocycle on the nose — E2 consumes the datum with zero bridging. Degree lane, W6-lite: cohomology of a Picard class is well-defined, degree by degree — h⁰(𝒪(D)) = h⁰(𝒪(D′)) and h¹(𝒪(D)) = h¹(𝒪(D′)) whenever [𝒪(D)] = [𝒪(D′)], plus the Subsingleton-H¹ and finiteness transports, all through one construction: extraction gives D − D′ = div g, the multiplication isomorphism gives the sheaf iso, and the cohomology transport finishes — finiteness-free, the carbon copy of the landed χ-invariance twin in each degree. The worksheet's prediction confirmed: W6-lite collapsed from a campaign to 137 lines on landed API; the packaged h⁰/h¹-of-a-class deliberately NOT introduced (a choice-of-witness indirection with no consumer — FLV consumes the equalities directly, which is what makes its per-class statements well-posed).
